rationale.model_calls: The ordinary research loop allowed 30 model calls as a runaway guard.
rationale.monthly_model_calls: The owner authorized 21 calls per company for the automatic monthly batch.
rationale.run_seconds: The research deadline starts before gather and leaves time for review and repair after acquisition.
rationale.model_call_seconds: Research and batch comparisons both allowed a single model request up to 600 seconds.
rationale.acquisition_seconds: Report 108 used 562 seconds for 72 tool calls; the shared acquisition window leaves time for final writing and review.
rationale.acquisition_rounds: Report 83 (688578) hit the old 12-round guard during normal repair; exploration and repairs share 24 rounds.
rationale.fetch_calls: The 601600 external-condition study needed more than 24 ordinary evidence fetches.
rationale.explore_tool_calls: The exploration guard bounds prompt growth from calculations as well as fetches.
rationale.repair_extra_tool_calls: Both repairs share 48 extra tool calls that exploration cannot consume.
rationale.draft_call_reserve: Reserve calls for writing, one declined tool turn, review and one format correction.
rationale.no_progress_rounds: Acquisition stopped after two consecutive rounds added no evidence.
rationale.review_rounds: The author could submit an initial draft and two repairs for independent review.
rationale.review_format_corrections: Each independent review allowed one correction of a malformed decision.
rationale.full_rewrites_per_invalid_patch: An invalid repair patch allowed one full replacement draft.
rationale.comparison_attempts_per_task: Each batch comparison allowed an initial response and one correction.
rationale.monthly_batch_model_calls: Thirty companies at 21 calls plus three comparisons at two attempts total 636 calls.
